_doc: Real bus -> VZ-DPOlomouc-bus object. Object names follow VZ-DPOlomouc-<family>-<livery>-<core> (the pak's DPMO bus families, pak128 commit 0c2cc6a, on main b84c15c). The livery comes from the register paint: DPMO white-blue-red, or plain lime green (616-618), or plain white (615); an advert wrap (CVR ...) maps to the type's normal DPMO livery (the pak session's rule). Articulated buses are two objects (-A front, -B rear), shown by the first core. Installed objects are read from the pak checkout (assets/pak_objects.json is the snapshot); any other object named here is 'requested'.

Solaris Urbino 12 II.note: Urbino 12 II and III share one body at this scale (the pak's Urbino_12 family).

Solaris Urbino 12 III.note: Urbino 12 II and III share one body at this scale (the pak's Urbino_12 family).
